outcome: Time from drug administration to amniotic fluid rupture
Time from drug administration to beginning of regular contractions
Time from drug administration to vaginal labor or caesarean section
Duration of labor stages (I, II, and III)
cohort: 50 adult patients qualified for labor induction
finding: Intravaginal misoprostol at a dose of 0.2 mg was associated with a shorter time to amniotic fluid rupture, beginning of labor, and delivery compared to intracervical dinoprostone at a dose of 0.5 mg.
